edition: Georgia DNR map created September 2014; underlying 2005-2012 deer-vehicle collision records described in 2015 study
metric: County peak deer movement week, estimated from deer-vehicle collision timing; not an exact conception date or live observation
quality: Historical county-centered movement proxy. Study pooled each county with adjoining counties and smoothed weekly collisions with a three-week running average. Study Results explicitly identify Stewart, Quitman, Randolph, and Clay as the only counties with fewer than 100 pooled records; their estimates have low accuracy. Exact county sample counts are unavailable here. This is not an observed 2026 movement report.
boundaryEdition: 2024 Census cartographic boundaries, 1:20 million; borders approximate
extraction: Native PDF text table; all 159 distinct names matched exactly after punctuation/case normalization to 159 Census Georgia counties; values remain source weekly ranges. Low-sample flags recovered from Results on printed page 204 of the original 2015 study.
ownership: Wildlife map author metadata identifies Georgia DNR; agency website links the PDF. Underlying factual dates extracted, map art is not republished. No explicit open license located. Census boundary data is a US federal public dataset.
